title.label: Just the Right Fit for Me!

content.label:
It took a bit of learning and rearranging of my mind to convince me to use the tag system instead of a file system, the latter of which Bear does not support and the former which it functions on, but once I figured out that system I was HOOKED! I love this app so much and I am slowly making it my Second Brain and writing hub for (almost) all my needs. It rivals Obsidian.md and Notion, both of which I have used previously but have not suited my needs perfectly.

Although I gave Bear five stars there is one thing I think they could implement to make things better: tables. I don’t know if this is in the works or not but if it was implemented I’d want to give Bear SIX stars!!!

(Customizing your own themes would be cool too. I’d personally like the red in Red Graphite to be Mustard Yellow Graphite, but that’s just a personal preference)

All in all a wonderful app and I don’t regret going Pro at all! Thank you so much Bear Team for all your hard work!

title.label: Wonderful: my daily driver for notes and writing

content.label:
The features are great and the price is right. Now, adding spotlight search. Cannot be beat I use this for reading and writing. It displays text cleanly and crisply. This sits on my dock and I use it every day. Other apps use fancy formatting and blocks and all manner of stuff. Those apps have their place and their purpose.  Bear handles my text perfectly. Enough said.

Sync is perfect and instant.  Markdown, encryption and themes.  Love and it and cannot wait for Panda

I am not a business person. I am not a student anymore either, so I really didn’t need anything super fancy. I use Bear to keep track of mental health and journaling, and the tagging system is just perfect for that. I can tag events, issues I’m having, or things I want to bring up in therapy and it makes it very easy to find what I need. I like how simple and robust it is, and it is so clean and just nice to look at. Other note apps are so busy and it’s honestly just annoying. The ability to use on my MacBook and iPad is amazing as well. I originally got this app before I went from android to iPhone and this app was one of the few reasons I switched over to iPhone–so I could have it at my fingertips wherever I went. The customization options are pleasing as well, I like the colors and dark mode options. Overall, I could sing the praises of this app for eternity. I am happy to pay for pro (which is so so sooo affordable compared to most quality note apps) and support these awesome creators doing what they’re doing. Thanks! This app is a game changer!
It just keeps getting better!

I would love it if they would take out the markdown syntax. Do I really need to see H2 next to my headers? Does **bold** really have to look like that? I understand markdown conceptually, but other apps keep the editors clean, I wish Bear did too.

title.label: Such a great app for incredible organization!!

content.label: I love beat, it has completely changed my life when it comes to organization. Almost feels like programming my life, so good. I miss not being able to save my notes in folders for specific subjects, but it’s manageable with the tags. Love it love it love it!!!! Totally recommend!

title.label: I’m in love and I never write reviews

content.label:
Best. Notes. App. I’ve ever used. Goodbye Evernote. 

Beautiful. (Huge for me, I will use the tool if it’s a joy)
Great user experience; simple and easy yet powerful app 
Awesome search 
iCloud sync (so my data stays with me)

I’ve really wanted tag hierarchies for a while… and I keep finding other features I’ve always wanted or ones I didn’t even think about. 

And the app itself is super customizable (font, size, page layout) but it’s already beautiful and a joy to use I don’t know that I’ll change anything. 

I’ve been using markdown for notes for work (with heading based folding— which would be a cool option for Bear :) but for personal life just Evernote, for sync and because I have a lot of stuff in there. Also hard to find a good editor I like on a phone. 

Loving it so far. Almost immediately bought the pro version. No regrets. 

Super happy to have this for writing too (like creative writing). Great way to tie things together.

The Bear app for Mac and iPhone integrate seamlessly. This is the one and only subscription pro app I pay for. 

I wish Bear had it’s own ecosphere.

I seriously love this app, I don’t often write reviews but I’ve used this app so much and it is one of the nicest notes apps that I’ve used. The style is clean and simple, the functionality is great, and the upgraded features are cheap and plentiful for what they cost.

As for new things:
I’m switching to a windows device and am sad to let this app go in search for a new app, windows support or a windows version would be awesome. I know there is a lot that goes in to that port but it would be cool.
I would also like to see the ability to write using either an apple pencil or a stylus as I feel many people take notes both typing and writing.

title.label: Syncing between phone and laptop doesn’t work

content.label: Syncing between phone and laptop doesn’t work. Otherwise this would be a cool product.
Clean interface and a bunch of useful features without going overboard and making things too complicated.

As a technical writer and occasional code monkey, this app has been a godsend for my technical write ups, brainstorms, and code snippets. I can drop illustrations/photos/screenshots in from every device and mark down tools make formatting effortless. My favorite parts are the dead-simple cross linking between notes, export options and the beautiful interface. 

Clean and easy, I can write from my phone(usually using dictation) when away from my desk and slide right in where I left off on my Mac or PC. A must have!!!
Fonts are to small and to light may be ok for young eyes, but not old ones. When I was young I could remember things and didn’t need Bear, now that I’m old, I can’t see my note

This is undoubtedly the most useful notes app you will probably ever need. Of you have come upon moments where you think of noting down something but couldn’t recall which app to exactly do that with then Bear will solve that problem for you. Using bear notes will become a reflex for you

title.label: This one is the best by far

content.label: I have tried them all and bear is by far the best. Can’t wait for v.2
This is the best notebook I’ve ever used. Thanks! 🙌
This bug deleted ALL of the work data I had.  I am just returning to work, and everything is gone because I am just finding out about this bug now.  Deleted app, and instead I will be using Obsidian.

title.label: Been using for years, still no basic search functionality

content.label: Title says it all. I’ve been patiently waiting for years for an update that would finally allows us to have some basic search functionalities to no avail. I admire bear for it’s simplicity (that’s what prevented me from deleting it altogether despite competitors like evernote and onenote offering search and so many more features) but when even the most rudimentary tasks such as being able to find and jump to a phrase in a long note is not possible, I consider that just too simple to allow for any serious use cases. Having been a developer myself, I simply cannot understand why it is so hard for these devs to create a simple search function which has been requested over and over by hundreds of bear users. It certainly wouldn’t take lot of coding knowledge to add this basic feature so again I cannot understand why they still can’t seem to figure it out after years have come and went. That being said, I regret to say that my patience has worn thin and I can longer just hope that the issue will eventually be resolved. So I am officially deleting the app and would end by recommending  Evernote, onenote, or heck even the already included apple notes app over Bear if anyone reading this cares about basic search functionality.

title.label: Love it but change the avatar

content.label: I use this app as a complication on my Apple Watch. It’s useful because you can see your note on the watch i.e. it doesn’t just send it to your phone. My only suggestion is to change the avatar from a bear to something more related to a note. Otherwise, well done!
Unfortunately, it does not support the Arabic language
My favorite note app, and I have tried them all. Awesome integration with Zettelkasten thanks to the flexible and powerful tag system.
the tags are confusing and I cannot have folders.

title.label: This app only protects your data if you are paying

content.label: The free version  is a scam
Typed a bunch of stuff, copied it, opened a different app, nothing pasted, go back to Bear - ALL GONE. App deleted. Seems to happen to many people. What junk.

This app is the most beautiful app, not just notes app, but any app, that I’ve used. A close rival to its pure, inviting beauty is Things 3. In fact I think this app and Things 3 pair perfectly together for a beautiful and exceedingly efficient and effective way to manage your life.

Needs ability or setting to make the watch complication to go straight to audio record.  Too many clicks for it to be completely optimal. Also in that mode, might as well make the done button bigger, no need for the animation, just put a big fat done button there.  Make it pulastae as you speak if that makes you happy, because it’s really had to use that on rugged cases with a big lip.
Bear is a great markdown note taking app. However, the IOS version lacks an important feature, which is searching inside a note, could be really annoying sometimes.

Wanted to like this app; however I don’t like the reports of lost data due to sync issues and the like. Additionally, because there is no file system, versioning, or automated backups like Ulysses app I can see how Bear app could overwrite or loose data during edits or sync conflicts. I have seen the the same thing happen with Apple’s notes app; think it also uses a database backend.
Hahahaa poor Danilo. Please keep his pizza supply 🙏🏻

Not sure if it’s my phone (iPhone SE) or not but, even on the latest update there’s TONS of typing lag. There’s also ALWAYS conflicts between my laptop and my phone. Probably due to not updating fast enough. Not sure how to solve the issue but it’s very very annoying.

Bear didn't stick for me at first. Tagging and a big list of notes wasn't doing it. Once I started to use the wiki-like linking, my use of Bear took off. Either way you'd prefer to organize your notes, Bear does a good job of it.
Bear is good, I like it. Good job you all. (Sorry for my bad English)

This app is great for almost anything. I am familiar with Markdown so it was super easy to get into but even a complete newbie can get used to it in a few second due to how this app is built. Incredible app and useful. Definitely recommend it as a must-have!

This is beautifully designed and coded. Exquisite. And priced fairly, to my mind. However:

If you want to sync between devices (and this for the paid version, mind you) the only way you can do that is by running all your Bear notes on iCloud. 

Don’t know about you, but my notes, migrated from 10+ years on Evernote, are enormous. I would have to upgrade iCloud storage massively, just to run Bear. 

That might be ok for you, but it’s definitely not what I signed up for, and the process of unwinding the purchase is … not perfect either.

This works well as a notes or even in some cases for minor web work. I’ve tried many notes apps but this is the cleanest and most dependable app I’ve used. It works well with a simple toolset that makes it outstanding.

I’ve tried all of the popular writing and note taking apps out there. None beats Bear. This is easily the cleanest, most pleasing app of the bunch to use. It’s beautiful to look at and just works well. A close second is iA Writer, but they insist on being so barebones in their functionality that it just simply falls short in too many ways. Bear is like a supercharged iA Writer without feeling overwhelming. Fantastic job by the Bear team.

But one small request: please incorporate version history!
I use it mostly on my Apple Watch, work’s great. Update… keeps crashing on my Apple Watch 7 newest iOS. Will update my review when fix.

A lot of productivity apps are great at distracting you from the work that matters. But bar takes all the fluff and leaves you with a clean experience that you are sure to enjoy. 

I know the above paragraph might sound like an ad but that’s what using this app makes me feel.

The apple notes app is great but just not enough for me. So I moved things to Bear and couldn’t be happier. 

Please keep this app simple. Thank you :)

I love the export options and the overall format. I write articles, and notes for my website, sermons, and I have even written a book or two using bear. I have 1 issue! It seems the formatting is stuck on 8.5x11… I export into word to change it, for example into 6x9 for a print publication, however, Bear would be almost perfect if I could change the page formatting from the normal note/office page size of 8.5X11.

title.label: Can’t search for text within a note

content.label: …which only makes this a useful app if you only take short notes.

I use the app as a replacement app for Apple’s Notes. The graphics and interface are charming and worth the low subscription cost. I’d like to see the markdown marks disappear when I’m through writing and close the note. But it’s not a deal breaker for me.

I've been using this app for a couple of months now. I'm super particular about clean look, ease of use across devices, open format. Bear does all that and then some. It's been a daily workhorse for my work note taking, personal journaling, and just writing thoughts.
Crashes on start on Apple Watch 6, latest iOS, latest WatchOS

This app has been a game changing for my code snippets, note taking and documentation as a programmer. And with the upcoming Panda beta app tie-in this app will be a must-have. Tools are simple and powerful and support documentation are concise. Wonderful job by this team!

 Cheers!🥂

This app strikes a fine balance between simple and complicated. When you just want to write it does just that, but with the tools to markup, export to different formats, save to cloud,etc. 

Grouping files is very simple and intuitive. 

It’s very well integrated into the apple ecosystem and allows me to seamlessly change from my phone to my iPad without wasting a second.

Apple Notes app “dark mode” is far too dark, Bear offers a few options that make a default for people that need more refined dark mode options. 

Main complaint is the inability to keep cursor at the middle of the screen. Currently, while typing. the cursor continues down to the bottom of the screen and my eyes are forced to stay at the bottom of the screen. This is terrible for posture and eye health. Having a typewriter option where the cursor stays in the middle at all times would be amazing. 

Smaller complaint is the tagging system. Currently tags are unprotected all the bottom, really getting in the way. Having them default at the top would be great to avoid accidental deletion or having a fully protected “tag” section would be optimal.

I use Bear app across all my devices (iphone, mac and watch) for both work and personal stuff. Rely on it every day. Love the low subscription cost. To be honest, I would probably even pay more! Totally worth it. UI is amazing, tags system is super cool, search works well, fonts and overall design is beautiful. Privacy features are exactly as I want them to be - I have faceid/password protection on the app itself with extra per-note faceid/password protection for the notes with extra sensitive information. I love how those are blurred inside the app. This is the best notes app for apple devices by far. Highly recommend!

title.label: So solid, so clean, so likable, so friendly!

content.label:
I’m on my third year with the friendly Bear Pro app, and I truly enjoy using it. The file/folder/tagging technique used means I never have to search in my sidebar for a note or make a new folder there. This is one of my favorite features!!!

I left Evernote years ago and imported all of that mess to Bear. Over time I’ve cleaned that up.

Oh, and lest I forget, thank you Bear for making batch tagging. So helpful.

I hope this helps you decide what a great app this is, whether you  are a note hoarder, writer, cook, or bottle washer, this app will make you happy. And with Panda coming to Bear next year (2022) it is going to stand out among the many, many note-taking apps out there. 

A big Kudos and Thank you to the Bear team!

Nothing else compares to Bear. The interface is simple, clean, and easy to use. If you like spending more time actually writing notes and less time trying to understand the app, this is your note taking app. The devs regularly update the app with great features.
For the most part, Bear is great. If you have a Mac, it’s even better. But somehow, it doesn’t support tables at all. Really a let down.
